## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Pricing and paywall.**
      2 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 29, 2026 - Jul 30, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Daliza Daliza_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "Google Wallet is okay, but it has one downside. I had one card linked to my Google Wallet, and that card was also connected to two other accounts as backup funding sources. I use it mainly as my gas card.When there wasn't enough money on my main card, Google Wallet automatically pulled the money from my CashApp because it was linked as a backup payment method. I didn't realize it would do that. Now I have to block any Googl form/from CashApp so it doesn't keep taking money from there."
            2. _Lauren Messer_, Jul 30, 2026, 2/5: "it was really helpful to have the time I left my wallet at home. On the app I Swore it said "have the app open to use". Today at the store I was chatting with the checkout gal. Texting Gma for his groceries, got too close and it went through. The app was not open and luckily the transaction wasn't ready for payment so we could cancel it. I only ever used it once, I don't like how it tried to pay without the app open. Uninstalled it for safety reasons."
